ActOfFaith.description: This unit gets +10% <style=Stat_Chance>Crit Chance</style> and increases their <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crit Damage</style> by 25% each time a friendly <style=Aliance_Imperial>Imperial</style> unit dies or kills an enemy unit. Once this unit crits, this bonus resets.
ActOfFaith.name: Act of Faith

Ambush.description: The first time this unit is defeated, it leaves behind a <style=Decoy>decoy</style> and at the beginning of their next turn, if there is still a friendly decoy on the battlefield, it is resurrected with full <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> on a random friendly decoy and can immediately take a turn. <style=Character>Characters</style> resurrect before <style=NonCharacter>Non-Character</style> units.
Ambush.name: Ambush

BattleFatigue.description: If a friendly unit is defeated in an adjacent hex, there’s a <style=Stat_Chance>10% chance</style> that this unit flees and is removed from the battle. <style=Stat_Chance>+40%</style> if it was <style=Overkill>overkilled</style>.
BattleFatigue.name: Battle Fatigue

BeastSnagga.description: Deals +20% <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style> Damage to <style=Big_Target>Big Targets</style> and <style=Vehicle>Vehicles</style>. Has an added <style=Stat_Chance>10% chance</style> to <style=Stat_Block>Block</style> 20% of its max Health as Damage.
BeastSnagga.name: Beast Slayer

BigTarget.description: Due to its size, this unit benefits less from cover but also provides some obstruction to enemy sighting. Does not get any bonuses from <style=Tile_Grass>Tall Grass</style> and <style=Tile_Trench>Trenches</style>. Adjacent friendly units receive <style=Stat_Hits>-1 hit</style> from <style=Stat_Range>ranged</style> attacks, to a minimum of 1. Cannot be displaced.
BigTarget.name: Big Target

BlessingsOfKhorne.description: Deals <style=Stat>3%</style> more damage and receives <style=Stat>8%</style> less <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style> for each unit that was defeated in melee this battle. Counts up to a maximum of 8 defeated units.
BlessingsOfKhorne.name: Blessings of Khorne

BossAdjutant.description: This unit takes <style=Stat_Damage>-66% Damage</style>. At the end of each turn, this unit loses 1% of its current <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> for each time it was attacked that turn.
BossAdjutant.name: Boss Adjutant

Camouflage.description: <style=Stat_Range>Ranged</style> attacks against this character score <style=Stat_Hits>-1 hit</style>. This increases to <style=Stat_Hits>-2 hits</style> if this character is more than 2 hexes away from the attacker or to <style=Stat_Hits>-3 hits</style> when in <style=Tile_Grass>Tall Grass</style>. Attackers always score at least <style=Stat_Hits>1 hit</style>.
Camouflage.name: Camouflage

CloseCombatWeakness.description: Whenever this unit is adjacent – or started the turn adjacent – to enemy units, it deals <style=Stat_Damage>50% Damage</style> with <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style> attacks and <style=Stat_Damage>25% Damage</style> with <style=Stat_Range>ranged</style> attacks.
CloseCombatWeakness.name: Close Combat Weakness

ContagionsOfNurgle.description:
This unit is surrounded by an aura that expands over time. Enemies have 20% <style=Stat_Armor>Armour</style> while in this aura. If they stand in two or more overlapping enemy auras, they have 40% <style=Stat_Armor>Armour</style> instead.

Aura:
Round 1-2: <style=Stat_Range>range 1</style>
Round 3-4: <style=Stat_Range>range 2</style>
Round 5+: <style=Stat_Range>range 3</style>
ContagionsOfNurgle.name: Contagions of Nurgle

CrushingStrike.description: This unit deals <style=Stat_Damage>+50% Damage</style> with normal <style=Stat_Melee>Melee</style> attacks if it has not moved this turn.
CrushingStrike.name: Crushing Strike

Daemon.description: This unit has an additional <style=Stat_Chance>25% chance</style> to <style=Stat_Block>Block</style> up to 50% of its own current <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> stat.
Daemon.name: Daemon

Dakka.description: For attacks with <style=Stat_Range>range 3</style> or more, has <style=Stat_Hits>+2 hits</style> if the target is at <style=Stat_Range>range 2</style>.
Dakka.name: Dakka

Diminutive.description: Due to its tiny stature, this unit reduces incoming multi-hit attacks by <style=Stat_Hits>1 hit</style>, to a minimum of 1.
Diminutive.name: Diminutive

Emplacement.description: This unit always deals <style=Stat_Damage>-50% Damage</style> in <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style> and its <style=Stat_Range>ranged</style> attacks deal <style=Stat_Damage>+50% Damage</style> if it has not moved this turn.
Emplacement.name: Emplacement

Explodes.description: This unit <style=Explodes>explodes</style> on death, dealing <style=Stat>25%</style> of its max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> as <style=DMG_Direct>Direct Damage</style> to all adjacent units
Explodes.name: Explodes

FinalJustice.description: When this unit loses its last <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>, it immediately performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal attack</style> on an eligible target and is then defeated as normal, unless <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>
FinalJustice.name: Final Vengeance

Flying.description: Can traverse impassable hexes and enemies and move between any elevation.
Flying.name: Flying

GetStuckIn.description: For every 2 hits this unit scores with an attack against an enemy within range 2, it has a <style=Stat>30%</style> chance to score an additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>. If 2 or more friendly <style=Faction_Orks>Orks</style> or 4 or more friendly units are adjacent to the target, the chance is increased to <style=Stat>100%</style>.
GetStuckIn.name: Get Stuck In

Healer.description:
Can <style=Healing>heal</style> a friendly unit as its action.
The amount of <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> restored equals the Healer’s <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> multiplied by the highest number of <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> of any of their weapons.
Healer.name: Healer

HeavyWeapon.description: When this unit has not moved this turn, it deals <style=Stat_Damage>+25% Damage</style> with ranged attacks.
HeavyWeapon.name: Heavy Weapon

Immune.description:
This unit is immune to special hexes and <style=HexEffect>hex effects</style>, and cannot have its <style=Stat_Armor>Armour</style>, <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style>, <style=Stat_Movement>Movement</style> or <style=Stat_Range>Range</style> reduced.

Additionally, this unit cannot be <style=Debuff_Stunned>Stunned</style>, <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style> or <style=Debuff_Taunted>Taunted</style>, and does not receive knockback damage.
Immune.name: Immune

Impervious.description: Has to be hit by a <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crit</style> to take any Damage, but is instantly defeated by a <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crit</style>.
Impervious.name: Impervious

IndirectFire.description: Can fire over <style=Out_Of_Sight>obscuring</style> hexes and hit targets in <style=Tile_Trench>Trenches</style>
IndirectFire.name: Indirect Fire

InstinctiveBehaviour.description: If there are targets in range, this unit does not move and attacks the closest target.
InstinctiveBehaviour.name: Instinctive Behaviour

LetTheGalaxyBurn.description: All attacks have a <style=Stat>33% chance</style> to score an additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> and add <style=Tile_DespoiledGround>Despoiled Ground</style> to the hex of the attacked unit. If the attacked unit is already on a hex with a <style=HexEffect>hex effect</style>, the attack automatically scores an additional <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style> but does not add <style=Tile_DespoiledGround>Despoiled Ground</style>.
LetTheGalaxyBurn.name: Let the Galaxy Burn

LivingMetal.description: <style=Regenerate>Regenerates</style> <style=Stat>10%</style> of its max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> at the start of the players' turn. This unit is also <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style>
LivingMetal.name: Living Metal

MachineOfWar.description:
<style=MoW>Machines of War</style> stand beside the battlefield and provide two additional powerful abilities to use multiple times during the battle. Some of them cost <style=Resource_MachinesOfWarAmmo>Munitions</style> and some have a <style=Cooldown>cooldown</style> before you can use them. Machines of War cannot be targeted in their off-battlefield position and are destroyed when a battle is lost. 

Not every game mode allows to field Machines of War!
MachineOfWar.name: Machine of War

MartialKatah.description: <style=NormalAttack>Normal attacks</style> against this unit deal <style=Stat_Damage>-20% Damage</style>. This unit deals <style=Stat_Damage>+100% Damage</style> with all attacks against <style=Summon>Summons</style>.
MartialKatah.name: Martial Ka'tah

Mechanic.description:
Can <style=Repairing>repair</style> a friendly <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style> unit as its action.
The amount of <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> restored equals the <style=Mechanic>Mechanic</style>'s Damage multiplied by the highest number of <style=Stat_Hits>hits</style> of any of their weapons.
Mechanic.name: Mechanic

Mechanical.description: Cannot be healed, but can be repaired instead. Note: units with the Living Metal trait also count as being Mechanical
Mechanical.name: Mechanical

MkXGravis.description: Any incoming <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> has to go through <style=Stat_Armor>Armour</style> a second time. Does not apply to <style=Stat_CritDamage>Crits</style>
MkXGravis.name: Mk X Gravis

Object.description: Automatically takes its action, if any, at the beginning of the turn. Cannot be <style=Healing>healed</style> or <style=Repairing>repaired</style>. A player loses the battle if their only remaining units are <style=Object>Objects</style>
Object.name: Object

Overwatch.description: If this unit has not attacked during its turn, nor after that, it attacks when an enemy moves within range during the enemy's turn
Overwatch.name: Overwatch

Parry.description: This unit reduces incoming <style=Stat_Melee>melee</style> multi-hit attacks by <style=Stat_Hits>1 hit</style>, to a minimum of 1.
Parry.name: Parry

Psyker.description: When this unit performs a <style=NormalAttack>normal ranged attack</style>, it also deals 50% of its <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> to a random enemy adjacent to the target.
Psyker.name: Psyker

PutridExplosion.description: This unit explodes when defeated, dealing {[extraDmgPct]}% of its max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> as <style=DMG_Toxic>Toxic</style> Damage to all adjacent units except to <style=Faction_DeathGuard>Death Guard</style> units.
PutridExplosion.name: Putrid Explosion

RangedSpecialist.description: If this this unit did not start its turn adjacent to an enemy unit, it deals <style=Stat_Damage>+33%</style> Damage with ranged attacks.
RangedSpecialist.name: Ranged Specialist

RapidAssault.description: This unit has <style=Stat_Movement>+1 Movement</style> until it makes either a melee or ranged attack. Its first attack each battle and all following attacks it makes in the same turn deal <style=Stat_Damage>+25% Damage</style>.
RapidAssault.name: Rapid Assault

Resilient.description: If this unit is not already at <style=Stat_Health>1 Health</style> and would be defeated, its <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> is instead reduced to <style=Stat_Health>1 Health</style>, unless <style=Overkill>Overkilled</style>.
Resilient.name: Resilient

ShadowInTheWarp.description: Enemy <style=Psyker>Psykers</style> within 2 hexes deal 25% <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style>. Does not affect <style=Faction_Tyranids>Tyranid</style> <style=Psyker>Psykers</style>.
ShadowInTheWarp.name: Shadow in the Warp

Steppable.description: Will be destroyed if stepped on or if damaged, but can not be targeted.
Steppable.name: Steppable

Summon.description: Moves and attacks automatically at the beginning of its turn
Summon.name: Summon

SuppressiveFire.description: An enemy hit by this unit’s ranged attack becomes <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style>.
SuppressiveFire.name: Suppressive Fire

Swarm.description:
Attacks with <style=Stat_Hits>1 hit</style> per individual member of the swarm. Each incoming hit can deal <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> only to one member. Does not apply to <style=DMG_Blast>Blast Damage</style>.
For each member defeated, the swarm attacks with 1 fewer <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>. 
<style=Healing>Healing</style> this unit can revive dead members of the swarm.
Swarm.name: Swarm

Synapse.description: Friendly units within 2 hexes ignore the effects of <style=Instinctive_Behaviour>Instinctive Behaviour</style> and <style=Battle_Fatigue>Battle Fatigue</style>.
Synapse.name: Synapse

TeleportStrike.description:
This unit starts the battle in Deep Strike. 

Units in Deep Strike can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy, or they can move normally from their current position. They cannot be targeted or damaged until they have taken an action or ended their turn.
TeleportStrike.name: Deep Strike

TerminatorArmour.description: The first attack each turn against this unit deals <style=Stat>-75% Damage</style>. <style=Stat_Hits>Hits</style> dealing <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic</style> or <style=DMG_Direct>Direct</style> Damage are excluded. This unit cannot be <style=Debuff_Pinned>Suppressed</style>.
TerminatorArmour.name: Terminator Armour

ThrillSeekers.description: Each turn, when this unit takes Damage or targets an enemy with full Health, it becomes Thrilled for 1 round. While Thrilled, its Crit Chance is increased by +15% and if it defeats an enemy with a Crit, that enemy is always overkilled.
ThrillSeekers.name: Thrill Seekers

TwoManTeam.description: Takes a maximum of <style=Stat>50%</style> of its max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> in <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> from a single <style=Stat_Hits>hit</style>. Does not apply to <style=DMG_Blast>Blast Damage</style>. Once below <style=Stat>50%</style> of its max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style>, cannot be <style=Healing>healed</style> above <style=Stat>50%</style> of its max <style=Stat_Health>Health</style> again.
TwoManTeam.name: 2-man Team

Unstoppable.description: This unit does not have to stop on special hexes and <style=HexEffect>hex effects</style> that would normally force a unit to end their <style=Stat_Movement>Movement</style>.
Unstoppable.name: Unstoppable

Vehicle.description: This unit does not have to stop on special hexes and <style=HexEffect>hex effects</style> that would normally force a unit to end their <style=Stat_Movement>Movement</style>. Does not get any bonuses from <style=Tile_Grass>Tall Grass</style> and <style=Tile_Trench>Trenches</style>. This unit is also <style=Mechanical>Mechanical</style>.
Vehicle.name: Vehicle

WeaverOfFate.description: In any turn where 3 or more enemy units have taken <style=DMG_Psychic>Psychic Damage</style>, this unit will deal the maximum possible <style=Stat_Damage>Damage</style> with its attacks and abilities on that turn.
WeaverOfFate.name: Weaver Of Fates
